title: Vedran Soric - Videos
description:
Vedran Soric is a sales trainer and consultant with 20+ years of experience in the sales owning 2 companies dealing with sales - Sorbel Group & Prodajni Mindset.

With managerial positions in several corporations and entrepreneurial experience from four companies, he has built a reputation as a dynamic, results-oriented individual with a strong presence. 

Since the beginning of his sales career he has held various positions in the sales sector, ranging from sales representative, Key Account Manager, regional sales manager, business development manager, to sales director, and ultimately executive director and board member.

He shares his experience with his lecture participants, using numerous examples from his practice. Since his university days, he has had a special passion for lecturing and motivational speaking, having delivered over 10,000+ hours of in-house training in Croatia and abroad. 

In 2022, he compiled his experience and knowledge into a book titled "Sales Mindset."
